name: Midas Fasanara Global Open
oneLiner: mGLO is a NAV-accreting Midas tokenized certificate giving exposure to Fasanara's open-ended private-credit receivables fund.
collateral: Tokenized exposure to Fasanara SA SICAV-RAIF mGLOBAL Fund (SF 36, Class A USD ACC): an asset-backed lending portfolio investing primarily in short-dated SME trade receivables and digital invoices, held through Midas tokenized-certificate rails (Compartment mGLO; JTC valuation email subject references ISIN LU3357216087).
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting Midas tokenized certificate; primary issuance and redemption occur through Midas permissioned rails at independently calculated NAV rather than a fixed $1 peg.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos Listing Policy v2 PR-3 Batch 1
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Midas and the vlayer-notarized JTC Luxembourg valuation attestation (subject: LU3357216087 - mGLO) identify mGLO (Compartment mGLO) as a NAV-linked security certificate referencing Fasanara SA SICAV-RAIF mGLOBAL Fund (SF 36, Class A USD ACC), a managed short-duration receivables and asset-based private-credit strategy. Because holders receive NAV-accreting certificate exposure rather than a fixed-par dollar claim, rwa-credit-fund preserves the underlying instrument structure.
